mapper.select: select id, user_id, rule_id, event_type, biz_no, change_points, before_balance, after_balance, description, create_by, create_time from wl_point_record where biz_no = #{bizNo} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into wl_point_record(user_id, rule_id, event_type, biz_no, change_points, before_balance, after_balance, description, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag) values(#{userId}, #{ruleId}, #{eventType}, #{bizNo}, #{changePoints}, #{beforeBalance}, #{afterBalance}, #{description}, #{createBy}, now(), '', now(), '0')
